title: Smoked Beef Pirozhki
description: A unique twist on traditional Russian pirozhki, filled with smoked beef and Thai flavors.
instructions: Thaw pirozhki dough according to package instructions.
Cut smoked beef into small pieces and set aside.
In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add beef to the pan and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, and salt to the pan, and stir to combine.
Roll out pirozhki dough to desired thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, and press edges together to seal.
Brush tops of pirozhki with remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil.
Place pirozhki on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped cilantro.
